cleavage agent: Excised protein bands following SDS- PAGE were digested in gel with trypsin and analyzed by mass spectroscopy.
enrichment method: We adopted an unbiased approach comprising of RNA-affinity chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry to identify RBPs which interact with the 3ʹUTR of PDCD4 mRNA and potentially regulate PDCD4 mRNA translation/turnover.
fractionation method: Excised protein bands following SDS- PAGE were digested in gel with trypsin and analyzed by mass spectroscopy.
fragmentation method: followed by CID-based MS/MS, performed in the scan range of m/z 100 and m/z 2000.
instrument: Full MS in the mass range between m/z 375 and m/z 1700 was performed on an Orbitrap Mass analyzer
labeling: Excised protein bands following SDS- PAGE were digested in gel with trypsin and analyzed by mass spectroscopy.

precursor tolerance: the peptide mass tolerance threshold was set to 10 ppm
